# @vanya/ui (Hearth & Wave Design System)

> Contemplative craft design system for Vanya Afanasov's autonomous workspace, tools, and creative apps.
> Stack: Tailwind CSS v4 (@theme inline), OKLCH dual-theme (Warm Paper Archive light vs Warm Dark Charcoal dark), Fraunces + Manrope + JetBrains Mono lowercase, micro-radii (2-4px), hairline borders.

## Philosophy & Core Rules
- **Color on Data (Rule of 5%):** Max 3-5% colored pixels. Chrome and surfaces are monochrome warm charcoal/paper. Accent color is reserved for living focus (amber #ffb266) or alerts (carmine #d92027).
- **Single Elevation:** Either a 1px hairline border (`oklch(1 0 0 / 12%)` dark, `oklch(0 0 0 / 10%)` light) OR a surface background step. Never combine with soft drop shadows.
- **No AI Slop:** No icons in filled round circles. No gradient text. No kickers/eyebrows above headings. No radii > 4px.
- **Typography Trinity:**
  - `Fraunces`: narrative dates, identity, quotes. Never for buttons or labels.
  - `Manrope`: UI labels, card headers, buttons, prose body text.
  - `JetBrains Mono`: code, ports, timestamps, metrics, strictly in `lowercase`.

## Tokens (CSS Variables)

| Token | Dark (Warm Charcoal) | Light (Warm Paper) | Role |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--ground` | `oklch(0.185 0.008 65)` (#181816) | `oklch(0.964 0.008 85)` (#f6f5f0) | Page background |
| `--surface` | `oklch(0.235 0.010 65)` (#22221f) | `oklch(0.979 0.006 85)` | Card / drawer surface |
| `--surface-raised` | `oklch(0.270 0.012 65)` | `oklch(0.992 0.004 85)` | Hover state |
| `--ink` | `oklch(0.930 0.008 75)` (#ece4d6) | `oklch(0.265 0.012 60)` (#181816) | Primary text |
| `--ink-soft` | `oklch(0.680 0.012 75)` | `oklch(0.560 0.014 70)` | Secondary text |
| `--amber` | `#ffb266` | `oklch(0.530 0.135 42)` | Focus / activity flame |
| `--hairline` | `oklch(1 0 0 / 12%)` | `oklch(0 0 0 / 10%)` | 1px border |

## Components API

### 1. CraftCard
- **Import:** `import { CraftCard } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Props:** `children: ReactNode`, `className?: string`, `isInteractive?: boolean`, standard `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.
- **Usage:**
  ```tsx
  <CraftCard isInteractive onClick={handleClick}>
    <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-ink">Project Title</h3>
    <p className="text-xs text-ink-soft">Description</p>
  </CraftCard>
  ```

### 2. Kbd
- **Import:** `import { Kbd } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Props:** `children: ReactNode`, `lit?: boolean` (active amber state), `className?: string`.
- **Usage:**
  ```tsx
  <Kbd lit={isPressed}>Esc</Kbd>
  ```

### 3. CategoryBadge
- **Import:** `import { CategoryBadge } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Props:** `category: "Creative" | "Infra" | "Life" | "Product" | string`, `className?: string`.
- **Colors:**
  - `Creative`: amber #ffb266
  - `Infra`: sky #38bdf8
  - `Life`: emerald #34d399
  - `Product`: rose #fb7185
- **Usage:**
  ```tsx
  <CategoryBadge category="Creative" />
  ```

### 4. SegmentedControl
- **Import:** `import { SegmentedControl } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Props:** `items: { id: string; label: string; count?: number; icon?: ReactNode }[]`, `value: string`, `onChange: (id: string) => void`, `size?: "sm" | "xs"`.
- **Usage:**
  ```tsx
  <SegmentedControl
    items={[{ id: "1d", label: "Сегодня", count: 2 }, { id: "7d", label: "Неделя" }]}
    value={horizon}
    onChange={setHorizon}
  />
  ```

### 5. RangeSlider
- **Import:** `import { RangeSlider } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Props:** `label?: string`, `min?: number`, `max?: number`, `step?: number`, `value: number`, `onChange: ChangeEventHandler`.
- **Usage:**
  ```tsx
  <RangeSlider label="Зум" value={zoom} min={1} max={100} onChange={e => setZoom(+e.target.value)} />
  ```

### 6. HearthPulse
- **Import:** `import { HearthPulse } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Props:** `label?: string`, `className?: string`.
- **Usage:**
  ```tsx
  <HearthPulse label="очаг активен" />
  ```

### 7. MeshStatusBadge
- **Import:** `import { MeshStatusBadge } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Props:** `status: "online" | "standby" | "warning" | "offline"`, `label: string`, `metricNote?: string`, `onClick?: () => void`.
- **Usage:**
  ```tsx
  <MeshStatusBadge status="online" label="gbrain serve" metricNote="38ms" onClick={openDrawer} />
  ```

### 8. InspectDrawer
- **Import:** `import { InspectDrawer } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Props:** `isOpen: boolean`, `title: string`, `onClose: () => void`, `children: ReactNode`.
- **Behavior:** Slides from right, has backdrop-blur, handles Escape key and outside click.

### 9. ActionButton
- **Import:** `import { ActionButton } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Props:** `variant?: "default" | "subtle" | "amber"`, `disabled?: boolean`, standard `ButtonHTMLAttributes`.
- **Usage:**
  ```tsx
  <ActionButton variant="amber" onClick={doSave}>Сохранить</ActionButton>
  ```

### 10. ThemeToggle & useTheme
- **Import:** `import { ThemeToggle, useTheme } from "@vanya/ui";`
- **Hooks:** `const { theme, resolvedTheme, setTheme } = useTheme();`
- **Component:** `<ThemeToggle variant="segmented" />` or `<ThemeToggle variant="icon" />`.
